digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, Design

stories.headline: Amazon Acquires Decart's AI Stack for $7.5B
stories.blurb: Amazon acquired AI optimization startup Decart to enhance compute efficiency and lower costs across Nvidia GPUs, Google TPUs, and AWS Trainium chips.

stories.headline: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.blurb: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following US government consultations confirming no national security risks exist.

stories.headline: DeepMind Uses Gemini Agents to Accelerate Quantum Algorithms
stories.blurb: Google DeepMind leveraged Gemini 4 agents verified by the Lean theorem prover to optimize quantum algorithms, reducing compute costs by up to 11.8x.

stories.headline: Z.ai Launches GLM-5.4 Loop Transformer Architecture
stories.blurb: Z.ai released GLM-5.4, a 750-billion-parameter flagship model built on a Loop Transformer that reuses layer blocks to perform deeper reasoning without increasing parameter counts.

stories.headline: Google Supercharges Transformer Residual Connections
stories.blurb: Google's DeepCrossAttention replaces traditional residual connections with dynamic feature routing, reducing transformer parameter counts by 30-40% while accelerating training convergence.

stories.headline: CrowdStrike to Acquire Zscaler for $43.9B
stories.blurb: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock deal to consolidate endpoint, zero-trust networking, and threat intelligence under a unified enterprise security platform.

stories.headline: OpenAI and Cisco Release Shirudo eBPF Security Shield
stories.blurb: Shirudo is an open-source runtime that uses eBPF to deploy temporary zero-downtime security shields on live Linux systems while permanent patches are deployed.

stories.headline: Critical Cisco Expressway Zero-Day Under Active Attack
stories.blurb: CISA added an unauthenticated Cisco Expressway remote code execution flaw to its KEV catalog after attackers actively exploited vulnerable gateways to access internal networks.

stories.headline: Microsoft Outlines Root Causes Behind Mass M365 Outage
stories.blurb: Microsoft's final incident report revealed that an undetected Windows defect overwhelmed over 80% of North American gateway servers due to load testing and failover gaps.

stories.headline: Datadog Launches Mitigeddon Vulnerability Telemetry Platform
stories.blurb: Datadog introduced Mitigeddon, a free platform tracking real-world CVE exploitation that demonstrates only 0.6% to 0.8% of vulnerabilities are actively targeted in production.

stories.headline: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for GitHub Automation
stories.blurb: Anthropic released Claude Ship, a suite of GitHub agents designed to automatically review code, fix pull requests, and enforce team policy checks.

stories.headline: Figma Brings AI Agent to Dev Mode for Design Handoffs
stories.blurb: Figma integrated an AI assistant directly into Dev Mode, enabling engineering teams to inspect design specs, compare iterations, and generate asset download links without altering canvas files.

stories.headline: Establishing Machine-Readable Design Systems for AI Agents
stories.blurb: Kirupa introduced ROFL, a design system framework that provides machine-readable tokens and structural rules to maintain UI consistency and accessibility in AI-generated web interfaces.

stories.headline: Project Zero Discovers PE Header Hardening Bypass in Windows
stories.blurb: Google Project Zero demonstrated how flipping a single bit in a .NET assembly header bypasses Windows process hardening and integrity checks to execute untrusted code.
